raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.26.0"

package:
  name: huggingface_hub
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/h/huggingface_hub/huggingface_hub-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c8cd4e2df1ba9402f77fce9b509ec1d52debb502551789473f34016acc14e361

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - hf=huggingface_hub.cli.hf:main
      - huggingface-cli=huggingface_hub.cli.deprecated_cli:main
      - tiny-agents=huggingface_hub.inference._mcp.cli:app

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - click >=8.4.2,<9.0.0
    - filelock >=3.10.0
    - fsspec >=2023.5.0
    - hf-xet >=1.5.1,<2.0.0
    - httpx >=0.23.0,<1
    - packaging >=20.9
    - pyyaml >=5.1
    - tqdm >=4.42.1
    - typing_extensions >=4.1.0
tests:
  - python:
      python_version:
        - '*'
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
      pip_check: true
      imports:
        - huggingface_hub
  - script:
      - hf --help
      - tiny-agents --help

about:
  summary: Client library to download and publish models, datasets and other repos on the huggingface.co hub
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface_hub
